The '''giant scarab''' is a monster fought during the final battle of the [[Contact!]] quest. The Scabarites set it to guard the place where they killed [[Kaleef]], close by the chasm under Sophanem, a direct route to their nest. It is constituted of three scarab swarm that merge together, which disperse and flee once the beast is killed. 

The giant scarab summons level 75 [[locust rider]]s and [[scarab mage]]s to aid it in its battle. It hits upwards of 200 life points with [[melee]] and [[ranged]] and is very [[poisonous]], with the damage starting at 98 per hit. If the players are out of [[melee]] range from the giant scarab and are using [[Protect from Ranged]], a message will say "The scarab clacks its mandibles and you are mystically poisoned," so you will be poisoned anyway, unless you drink [[antipoison]] or are holding an [[anti-poison totem]].

The grey object in its back is [[Kaleef]]'s [[keris]] dagger.

The giant scarab is fightable as a class D boss monster in the [[Dominion Tower]] minigame if the player has completed [[Contact!]]. During the Dominion Tower battle, however, the player can use keris, and the riders and mages that the scarab summons are level 75.
